name: assert-dao
description: Quadratic voting for the members of the ASSERT Association

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint -w web && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:contracts: cd contracts && forge fmt --check && forge lint --deny notes && solhint --max-warnings 0 'src/**/*.sol' 'script/**/*.sol' 'test/**/*.sol'
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm test -w web && npm run test:integration -w web
scripts.gas:check: cd contracts && FORGE_SNAPSHOT_CHECK=true forge test --match-contract GasTest
scripts.mutate: cd contracts && uvx --from slither-analyzer==0.11.6 slither-mutate src/AssertDAO.sol --contract-names AssertDAO --timeout 180 --test-cmd 'forge test --no-match-path "test/fork/*" --no-match-contract GasTest'
